title: New internal primers targeting short fragments of the mitochondrial COI region for archival specimens from the subfamily Aphidiinae (Hymenoptera, Braconidae)
author: Mitrović, Milana
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Direct PCR LCO1490/Lys1Rd
steps.instruction: Perform a direct PCR using the primer pair LCO1490 and Lys1Rd on samples LD8 and LD9.

steps.title: Nested PCR with LCO1490/Lys1Rn and Lys1Fn/Lys1Rd
steps.instruction: Use the amplicons from the LCO1490/Lys1Rd reaction as template for two nested PCRs: one with primers LCO1490/Lys1Rn and another with primers Lys1Fn/Lys1Rd.

substeps.instruction: Set up nested PCR with primers LCO1490 and Lys1Rn using the previous amplicon as template.
Set up nested PCR with primers Lys1Fn and Lys1Rd using the previous amplicon as template.

steps.title: Direct PCR Aph2Fd/Lys2Rd
steps.instruction: Perform a direct PCR using the primer pair Aph2Fd and Lys2Rd on samples LD8, LD9, and LD12.

steps.title: Nested PCR with Aph2Fd/Lys2Rn and Lys2Fn/Lys2Rd
steps.instruction: Use the amplicons from the Aph2Fd/Lys2Rd reaction as template for two nested PCRs: one with primers Aph2Fd/Lys2Rn and another with primers Lys2Fn/Lys2Rd.

substeps.instruction: Set up nested PCR with primers Aph2Fd and Lys2Rn using the previous amplicon as template.
Set up nested PCR with primers Lys2Fn and Lys2Rd using the previous amplicon as template.

steps.title: Direct PCR Lys3Fd/HCO2198
steps.instruction: Perform a direct PCR using the primer pair Lys3Fd and HCO2198 on the appropriate samples (as described in the study).

steps.title: Nested PCR with Lys3Fd/Aph3Rn and Lys3Fn/HCO2198
steps.instruction: Use the amplicons from the Lys3Fd/HCO2198 reaction as template for two nested PCRs: one with primers Lys3Fd/Aph3Rn and another with primers Lys3Fn/HCO2198.

substeps.instruction: Set up nested PCR with primers Lys3Fd and Aph3Rn using the previous amplicon as template.
Set up nested PCR with primers Lys3Fn and HCO2198 using the previous amplicon as template.
